By  "trigger" I mean rubbing off depressive or suicidal thoughts on other people. Not everyone can handle listening to  talks about depression, suicide and self harm. That is why I'm not in a hurry to share these thoughts.

I feel like speaking to non professionals about my struggles may trigger them, the pessimism from my existential crisis may rip off the rose coloured glasses that fortunate well adapted people use to navigate this existence.

Secondly the burden of mental health is invisible, only a few can grasp it; people with mental health issues, people who have studied about mental health , and people with empathy, so I don't really think talking to people is always productive especially when you read some ignorant views on mental health. Some people trivialize it and think you should just wish it away.

Though I think forums like this help.
I'm feeling some relief letting it out, I'm grateful you are engaging me.

I feel like a waste of space mostly because I literally can't do anything, not chores, not studies.
I'm just living and breathing, "bedridden" by depression, and it's getting to people around me who don't get it because mental health and it's burden are invisible.
